concept.title: Sports and swimming sessions
concept.shortdesc: Taking part in sport, from swimming and water sports to team games, racket sports and bowls, including sessions, lessons, facility use and competitions.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Taking part in, learning, or hiring equipment for paddle and boat-based water sports such as kayaking, canoeing, paddleboarding, sailing and powerboat trips.
: Taking part in basketball sessions of any kind, including drop-in, taster, skills development, walking and beginner basketball.
: Organised swimming sessions, lessons, family or social swims and swimming clubs where people swim or learn to swim as an activity.
: Using a swimming pool or pools as a facility, often on a self-directed basis, including pool-and-gym access.
: Playing or trying bowls, including crown green, short mat and indoor bowls, in sessions, taster days and social games.
: Taking part in sport in general or a mix of different sports and games, rather than one named sport.
: Taking part in competitions, tournaments and the squad training or preparation that leads to them.
: Playing badminton and closely related indoor racket sports such as squash, racketball and pickleball, plus court hire for them.
: Football and soccer sessions, including free, recreational, skills-building and inclusive sessions for playing and learning the game.
: Regular weekly football sessions, open-access sessions and walking football for people wanting a gentler or social game.
